title: HB241 (2017 Regular Session): Modifies the crime of unlawful transfer of weapons to include transfer of a firearms to any person on the terrorist screening center's no fly list

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk dataset (gun-policy Stage 5 LegiScan check); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official house.mo.gov or senate.mo.gov PDF of the version named in note (via LegiScan getBillText)

operative_text:
Section 571.060 (RSMo): 1. A person commits the offense of unlawful transfer of weapons if he: (4) Knowingly sells, leases, loans, gives away or delivers a firearm to any person whose name appears on the terrorist screening center's no fly list.
Section 571.060 (RSMo): 2. Unlawful transfer of weapons under subdivisions (1) and (4) of subsection 1 of this section is a class E felony; unlawful transfer of weapons under subdivisions (2) and (3) of subsection 1 of this section is a class A misdemeanor.
